title: Tokenization and stablecoins may weather Democrats' sweep as broader crypto rules face uncertainty
summary: Wall Street's push to bring finance onto blockchain rails may continue under existing laws, though the SEC and CFTC face tougher oversight and questions over how long their rules will last, experts said.

title: Crypto's Washington hopes fade, but Grayscale and BlackRock see growth ahead
summary: The asset manager says global demand and institutional adoption will sustain the industry despite a political setback, while BlackRock sees little impact on its crypto business.

title: Crypto's powerhouse super PAC suffers costly setback as Democrats sweep Congress
summary: The industry's primary campaign arm had cultivated a reputation as an unstoppable force, but more than a third of its spending failed to hit the mark, especially in Ohio.

title: U.S. Democratic sweep could be the final nail in the ‘Clarity Act’s coffin’
summary: Industry experts warn the Clarity Act is likely dead in its current form as incoming Democratic majorities eye tighter scrutiny of crypto markets and tokenized stocks.

title: Wall Street rethinks AI data center boom as Texas election raises new risks
summary: Bitcoin miners pivoting to AI face new uncertainty over power access and construction permits, while companies with approved projects could benefit from tighter supply.
